title: Wallbox Charger Session Energy Delivered Leaderboard
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wallbox:session energy_kwh=*
| stats sum(energy_kwh) as total_value, avg(energy_kwh) as avg_value by charger_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks charger values by total and average energy delivered across Wallbox charger session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `energy_kwh` values for each Wallbox charger session event and review total and average energy delivered by charger.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total energy delivered.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep which charger shows the biggest energy delivered numbers in your Wallbox charger session data.
